Paper Title: SciNUP: Natural Language User Interest Profiles for Scientific Literature Recommendation (ECIR)
Aim / Objective: Benchmark profile-based scholarly recommendation with sparse, dense, LLM and ensemble methods
Limitation: Profiles are LLM-synthesized, not real user text; best model needs a paid LLM reranker
Accuracy / Results: RRF ensemble (best): R@100 0.4136, MAP 0.2163, MRR 0.6333, NDCG@10 0.4481; kNN-SciBERT: MAP 0.0232, MRR 0.2182

Paper Title: CiteBART: Learning to Generate Citations for Local Citation Recommendation (EMNLP)
Aim / Objective: Generate citations with citation-masked BART pretraining (Base vs Global variants)
Dataset Used: ACL-200, PeerRead, RefSeer, ArXiv (up to 3.7M contexts)
Limitation: Generative hallucinations (MaHR up to ~13% at top-10); weak on small datasets
Accuracy / Results: CiteBART-Global ACL-200: R@10 0.739, MRR 0.513; ArXiv: R@10 0.502, MRR 0.305

Paper Title: TextTAGC: A Query-Oriented Scientific Paper Recommendation Model Based on Temporal-Aware Graph Convolution (Scientometrics, Springer)
Aim / Objective: Fuse GNN citation structure with SPECTER text and publication-time encoding for cold-start query recommendation
Limitation: Homogeneous graph only; CS-domain only; coarse temporal modeling
Accuracy / Results: TextTAGCp DBLP: MAP 0.18213, MRR 0.5589, R@100 0.4643; AAN: MAP ~0.168, MRR ~0.43

Paper Title: PARK: Personalized Academic Retrieval with Knowledge-graphs (Information Systems, Elsevier; arXiv)
Aim / Objective: TransE/TransH user embeddings aligned with a fine-tuned MiniLM bi-encoder for personalized academic search
Dataset Used: 4 domains x ~5M docs, 1.9M training queries (CIKM benchmark)
Limitation: Needs complete citation graph (closed-world); 18M-doc scale; loses to popularity heuristic in CS
Accuracy / Results: PARK-H Physics: MAP@100 0.225, MRR@10 0.696; Psychology: MAP@100 0.255, MRR@10 0.712; MiniLM baseline: MAP@100 0.183-0.218
